_comment: Pinned configuration for E1, the cross-family Haiku reader. PREPARED 2026-10-19; NOT RUN. Every value marked PRE-REGISTERED comes from first_cheap_test_semantic_leak.md (13 Oct) or PLAN_haiku_reader.md (19 Oct, written before any reader output) and must not be changed without a DECISIONS.md entry. Values marked NEW are operational only: they affect cost, speed and failure handling, never the prompts, the items, the parsing or the decision rule.

model.note: A non-OpenAI, non-Qwen reader is required by the design: the teacher is Qwen and the paper's own classifier was GPT. Haiku 5.5 runs adaptive thinking by default and rejects budget_tokens; depth is controlled by output_config.effort only.
model.price_tier_note: Prices apply to prompts under 100K tokens; every prompt here is under 6K characters. Verified 13 Oct 2026 and reconfirmed against the bundled Claude API reference on 19 Oct 2026.
model.server_side_fallbacks_note: Not available for Haiku 5.5. A refusal is recorded as stop_reason 'refusal' and the item is scored invalid; no model substitution happens, which would be a silent design change.

request.effort_provenance: PRE-REGISTERED (run_reader.py AnthropicBackend, written 18 Oct before any reader ran)
request.thinking: omitted (adaptive is the Haiku 5.5 default; budget_tokens would return 400)
request.temperature_note: PRE-REGISTERED DEVIATION, already logged in PLAN_haiku_reader.md section 7: the design asked for temperature 0, Haiku 5.5 accepts only its default sampling, so this reader is stochastic. 500 pairs per type absorb the noise and the cache makes a finished run re-readable. score.py writes the deviation into the results automatically.
request.max_tokens_doubling_note: If the first call returns empty text with stop_reason max_tokens (thinking consumed the cap), the same request is retried once at double the cap. PRE-REGISTERED.

items.provenance: PRE-REGISTERED; identical file read by every reader so results are comparable

prompts.source: run_reader.py constants R1_SYSTEM, R1_TEMPLATE, R1_REMINDER, R2_SYSTEM, R2_HEAD, R2_TAIL, R2_REMINDER
prompts.note: Imported, never redefined here, so the Haiku reader sees byte-identical prompts to the Qwen reader.

run.stages_provenance: PRE-REGISTERED (PLAN_haiku_reader.md section 5): 3 items, then 30, then all, checking spend on the console between stages
run.reminder_retry_note: PRE-REGISTERED: items whose answer does not parse are asked once more with an explicit format reminder.

guards.max_tokens_total_provenance: PRE-REGISTERED (PLAN_haiku_reader.md section 4 item 3); implies a ceiling of about $0.75
guards.max_calls_provenance: NEW (operational): a second, independent ceiling. The pipeline can issue at most 4 calls per item (2 attempts x 1 doubled-cap retry) over 2060 items = 8240; 9000 leaves headroom and still stops a runaway loop.
guards.note: Both guards raise and stop the run. Everything already answered stays in the cache, so a stopped run resumes for free.

client.sdk_max_retries_note: The Anthropic SDK retries connection errors, 408, 409, 429 and 5xx with exponential backoff internally.
client.rate_limit_note: NEW (operational): applied only after the SDK's own retries are exhausted. Honours the retry-after header when present, else exponential backoff with jitter.

scoring.command: python score.py --answers outputs/answers_anthropic.jsonl --manifest outputs/items_manifest.json --teacher data/qwen/teacher_sanity.jsonl --out results_leak_test_anthropic.md --json outputs/score_anthropic.json
scoring.decision_rule: unchanged; score.py applies the pre-registered rule and reports Track A and Track B per DECISIONS.md D1

seeds.items_seed_note: Fixed when the items were built; this run reads them, it does not rebuild them.
seeds.sampling_seed_note: The Messages API exposes no sampling seed, and Haiku 5.5 does not accept temperature. Reproducibility comes from the response cache, not from determinism: a finished run is re-readable byte for byte, and a repeat run would be an independent sample.
